title: TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrend - Data API
description: Stores details of changes related to trusted IP ranges in Security Center.This object is available for Security Center subscribers in API version 54.0 and later.

Action.description: Stores information on a change to the policy. Available options include: ADDED REMOVED UPDATED

ActionBy.description: The name of the person who made this change.

Description.description: A description of the trusted IP range. For example, "Trusting the IP addresses from NA-West region".

DetailIdentifier.description: Unique identifier for this detail record.

IpEndAddress.description: The end IP address of a trusted IP range. For example, 10.0.0.0 – 10.255.255.255.

IpRangeIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the IP range.

IpStartAddress.description: The start IP address of a trusted IP range. For example, 10.0.0.0 – 10.255.255.255.

MetricIdentifier.description: The ID of the corresponding TenantSecurityMonitorMetric.

MetricsType.description: The type of metric for the data collected.

Name.description: The name of the metric for the data collected.

Tenant.description: The ID of the tenant (org) that this record is for.

TenantName.description: The name of the tenant (org) that this record is for.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrendChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrendFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrendHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrendOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTrustedIpRangeTrendShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
